caption: The drawing depicts an arrangement of various flowers and leaves grouped in a vertical composition. The flowers are illustrated in different colors, including pink, red, yellow, purple, blue, white, and orange, and they vary in size and type, with some having many petals and others having fewer. The leaves are mostly green, with some darker and lighter shades adding to the variation in the image. The stems and branches that the flowers and leaves grow from are brown and interwoven, forming the central structure of the arrangement. The background is a solid, light yellow color, and the entire composition is placed within a rectangular frame on a piece of paper. In the lower right corner, “Ruth. M. Barnes.” is written in small letters, and there are handwritten notations in the lower left corner.
title: Quilt
